retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast band portrait framed by a multi-layered neon border and topped with expressive, swash-heavy psychedelic lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic band portrait contained within a scalloped, multi-colored neon frame, set against a black background with large-scale decorative lettering overlapping the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The large swash lettering overlaps the top of the internal frame.
The multi-layered border creates a 'window' effect for the photography.
High-contrast lighting in the photo mirrors the vibrant neon colors of the frame.
The black outer margin provides a high-contrast base for the neon elements.
coreInvariants: Extreme swash extensions on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body band portrait centered within the internal frame, occupying 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant pink decorative lettering at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large pink text, follows the swash down to the frame, then moves into the central band portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins surrounding the central frame and text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta/pink for primary lettering and frame layers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and cream for secondary text and frame outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation neon colors against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme elongated swashes that loop back under the word
High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'F' features a massive top bar and a tail that underlines the entire word.
The 'y' features a descending loop that integrates with the frame.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme decorative script paired with a minimalist, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif feel with decorative extensions.
Matches the clean, geometric subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a four-person rock band in 70s attire (leather jackets, denim) standing in a dimly lit urban setting. Surround this photo with a multi-layered scalloped frame in magenta, cream, and cyan on a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom magenta psychedelic lettering in the top left corner with a long swash underlining the word. Add a cyan geometric sans-serif subtitle in the top right with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the primary text have an elongated swash?
Is the frame scalloped at the corners?
Are the colors magenta and cyan present?

mustAchieve: Vibrant neon glow effect on borders

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text swash does not obscure the band members' faces.
Verify the frame maintains its scalloped geometry.
Check that the black background is deep and uniform.
Confirm the neon colors pop against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Band Portrait + Scalloped Neon Frame + Psychedelic Swash Lettering + Black Negative Space
